title: Bag of Bricks- Caramel 15
descriptionHtml:
Caramel — colour 15

A warm golden brown that adds glow. Caramel flatters skin tones, golden retrievers and autumn scenes, and sits comfortably between the yellows and the browns as a blending shade.

Works well with: Toffee 29, Nougat 32, Yellow 11

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Caramel bricks (colour 15) for Memobrick mosaics. A warm golden brown that adds glow to skin tones, pets and autumn scenes.
